# Abhijit Satyaki

> Personal portfolio of Abhijit Satyaki, a Full Stack Developer and research co-author.

Website: https://abhijitsatyaki.me/
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/abhijitsatyaki/
GitHub: https://github.com/satyakiabhijit

## Professional profile

Abhijit Satyaki is a Full Stack Developer skilled in the MERN stack, REST APIs, TypeScript, React, Node.js, MongoDB, and responsive frontend development. His research interests include IoMT security, wearable IoT, BLE security, antenna design, explainable machine learning, quantum computing, and Edge AI.
